prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Sugar Land, Texas. Injury: neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1229; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant later added small details, but the account stayed the same.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. I had slowed nearly to a stop and had my turn signal on before I started across the lane. The impact threw my head sideways and I felt a sharp pain in my neck right away, along with stiffness that has continued since. I have been seeing a doctor for a neck strain. Since first reporting the incident, I have remembered a few minor details, such as the other driver's position and the traffic light color, but the core of what happened has not changed. I am the named driver on this policy and I am submitting this statement to support my claim.
